item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:50 HKT 16/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will linger over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow, there will be occasional heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. The trough of low pressure is expected to move inland early next week. Meanwhile, the coast of southern China will be under the influence of a southwesterly airstream. The weather will be hot apart from a few showers over the region.

Date/Month: 16/06 (Friday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
